uncited: This method integrates contribution-based ordering into existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) compression pipelines to improve visual quality at the time to First Paint (TFP) by streaming high-contribution primitives first.

It differs from standard compression by ensuring that the spatial or Morton ordering typically applied for storage efficiency does not overwrite the semantic importance ordering derived from rendering contribution.
- **Output:** A chunked compressed file where chunks are ordered by Gaussian contribution, allowing progressive rendering with higher initial quality.
- **Note on Morton Order:** The base compression method (Niedermayr et al.) sorts Gaussians in Morton order before saving to improve compression ratios.
- **Chunk Size:** Not specified in the sources.
Determines the granularity of progressive loading.
- **Codebook Usage:** This method requires per-Gaussian data storage with ID mapping.
